title: arenaria makmelensis
intro: Arenaria makmelensis, commonly known as the Syrian sandwort, is a flowering plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria makmelensis include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
